title: Shrimp and Grits
description: Creamy cheddar grits topped with shrimp in a smoky bacon, garlic and lemon pan sauce. A Southern classic for dinner or brunch.

image.alt: A bowl of creamy grits topped with shrimp, bacon and green onion

steps.text: Bring the water, milk and salt to a simmer in the saucepan. Slowly whisk in the grits, then lower the heat and cook, stirring often, until thick and creamy, {time 20-25 min}. Stir in the butter and cheese; keep warm, adding a splash of water if they get too stiff.
Meanwhile cook the bacon in the skillet over medium heat until crisp, {time 6-8 min}. Lift it out, leaving the fat.
Toss the shrimp with the paprika. Cook in the bacon fat over medium-high heat until pink, {time 1-2 min} per side. Add the garlic for {time 30 sec}.
Add the broth and lemon juice and simmer for {time 1 min}, scraping up the browned bits. Stir in the bacon and most of the green onions.
Spoon the grits into bowls and top with the shrimp and pan sauce. Scatter with the rest of the green onions.

notes: Stone-ground grits take longer, 40 to 50 minutes; follow the package and keep them loose with extra liquid.
